about_short_description.short_description: Carta is a global ownership management platform that helps companies, investors, and employees manage equity and ownership.

product.name: Carta Equity Suite
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing company equity, ownership records, fundraising transactions, valuations, employee compensation, liquidity events, and related compliance workflows.

product.name: Carta Fund ERP
product.description: An integrated software and services platform for fund administration, portfolio data, valuations, forecasting, tax processes, investor relationships, and private capital operations.

product.name: Carta Law
product.description: An attorney-led legal and compliance service for private capital firms, using AI-assisted workflows for contracts, AML/KYC reviews, investor transactions, and fund-related legal operations.

product.name: Carta Plugins for Claude
product.description: AI plugins that connect Carta equity, fund, and CRM records to Claude for querying data, generating reports, modeling scenarios, and automating private capital workflows.

product.name: Carta Launch
product.description: A free equity management product for early-stage companies to create and maintain a cap table and manage foundational ownership records.

product.name: Carta 401(k)
product.description: A workplace retirement plan offering that helps companies launch and manage a 401(k) program through Carta, powered by Vestwell and Morgan Stanley.
